                          # default endpoint for it, unlike Ollama's. An
                          # optional API key, if the server needs one, is read

                          # variable -- never from this file.

                          # UNSET by default: ollama then resolves OLLAMA_HOST
                          # or its own packaged default; openai-compatible has
                          # no default and refuses to start without this key.

                          # embedding requests, for when the embedding model is
                          # served by a different process or port than the

                          # fall back to base_url (or that backend's own

                          # `model:`), or name another tag. The packaged judge
                          # applies on the ollama backend only. A missing judge
                          # fails only its own stage, naming the pull command.

                          # Free-form -- the name is passed to the model
                          # verbatim, so a name it does not recognise is not an

                          # Setting it appends one sentence to both rationale
